title: Complex subtelomeric architectures in a complete rhesus macaque reference genome.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Zenodo record 10.5281/zenodo.17595612 holds only MMU8_code_archive.zip (44 KB, code); Zenodo 12693230 is the harmonypy software package. NCBI Datasets report for GCA_049350105.1 returned empty JSON. Europe PMC full text returned HTTP 500; supplement endpoint returned no zip.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Everything about content: a telomere-to-telomere genome assembly (GCA_049350105.1), ~8 Mbp of SATR satellite arrays, 268 new repeat families, four subtelomeric architectures, 58 transcribed genes — all from the abstract.

a1_downloadable.note: Assembly accession GCA_049350105.1 is public in NCBI per text mining; not downloaded (multi-gigabyte FASTA). Zenodo code archive is open.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Primary output is a genome sequence plus repeat annotation; no table of measured outcomes exists. Any label (e.g. repeat class, architecture type) would have to be constructed from annotation tracks. Checked Zenodo only; paper text not available.

a3_inputs_present.note: Sequence itself would be present in the assembly FASTA (not opened).

a4_units_stated.note: No measurement table to carry units.

a5_enough_rows.note: Only four subtelomeric architecture classes and 58 genes described in abstract; no labelled row set seen.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: No count could be verified; NCBI report empty, full text unavailable.

a8_label_provenance.note: Repeat-family and architecture labels come from annotation pipelines run on the same sequence, so a sequence-to-label model would be computed from its own features.

backbone.name: Nucleotide Transformer / DNABERT-2 (DNA language models) would be the only plausible fit

honest_claim_h3: No prediction target exists; a model could only re-derive repeat annotations from the sequence they were annotated on.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use DNA sequence near chromosome ends to predict which of four repeat-structure types a region belongs to.
plain_idea.train_on: Stretches of macaque subtelomeric DNA (chromosome-end regions) from the new complete genome; number of labelled regions unknown.
plain_idea.predict: The repeat-architecture class or repeat family, which the authors assigned by annotation software and manual curation, not by an independent measurement.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Would mainly help repeat annotators, but labels are derived from the sequence itself, so little would be learned.

label_elsewhere.sources: None identified; the subtelomeric architecture classes are defined in this paper only.
label_elsewhere.why: No external labelled data, so no generalisation test.

ml_idea: None viable: a reference-genome resource without a measured outcome table; repeat classes are annotation outputs derived from the sequence.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; project rejected at Part A.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Look for any supplementary table of measured per-region values (expression, accessibility) with hundreds of rows; none found.

verdict_reason: Genome assembly resource with no label column (A2); only deposited Zenodo item is a 44 KB code archive, and repeat labels are annotation outputs computed from the sequence (A8).
